pointers.sentence: Since 6.2 it is the first whose class overrides `BaseBackend.get_user` or `BaseBackend.aget_user` (`django/test/client.py:ClientMixin._get_backend`, `docs/releases/6.2.txt`).
Since 6.2 it is the first whose class overrides `BaseBackend.get_user` or `BaseBackend.aget_user` (`django/test/client.py:ClientMixin._get_backend`, `docs/releases/6.2.txt`).

Since 5.1 the request methods of `RequestFactory`, `AsyncRequestFactory`, `Client` and `AsyncClient` take `query_params=`, a mapping made the query string (`django/test/client.py:RequestFactory.generic`).
Under all four releases a relative `"Location"` raises `KeyError: 'PATH_INFO'`, and any other 307 or 308 raises `KeyError: 'REQUEST_METHOD'` (`django/test/client.py:ClientMixin._follow_redirect`).

The two share `SimpleTestCase._assert_contains`, which now sets `StreamingHttpResponse.streaming_content` again from the bytes it read (`django/test/testcases.py:SimpleTestCase._assert_contains`; [Assertions on a response: `assertContains`, `assertRedirects` and `assertTemplateUsed`](../testing/response-assertions.md)).
Since 5.1 it also replaces `BaseDatabaseWrapper.ensure_connection` while the class runs, "to enforce test isolation", the notes say (`docs/releases/5.1.txt`).

Under all four releases a query to such a database in a thread a test started raises `DatabaseOperationForbidden` for "threaded connections" (`django/test/testcases.py:SimpleTestCase.ensure_connection_patch_method`; [Which databases a test uses: `databases`](../testing/test-databases.md)).

Since 5.2 the fixtures and serialized rows of a `TransactionTestCase` that is not a `TestCase` are there in its own `setUpClass`, once it has called the parent's (`django/test/testcases.py:TransactionTestCase.setUpClass`; [Emptying the tables after each test: `TransactionTestCase`](../testing/transaction-test-case.md)).
Under forkserver it now does the same (`django/test/runner.py:_init_worker`; [Running in parallel: `ParallelTestSuite`](../testing/parallel.md)).
Before 6.0 `get_max_test_processes`, which `--parallel auto` asks, answered 1 under forkserver (`django/test/runner.py:get_max_test_processes`).
Under all four releases a test given in it is left out of the suite without a word (`django/test/runner.py:DiscoverRunner.build_suite`).

`setup_test_environment` gives each alias the local-memory backend, and sets `EMAIL_BACKEND` only where `MAILERS` is not defined (`django/test/utils.py:setup_test_environment`; [What changed in mail and tasks](mail-and-tasks.md)).
The runner's `setup_databases` serializes them once every test database is made (`django/test/utils.py:setup_databases`; [Test databases: `BaseDatabaseCreation`](../schema/test-databases.md)).
A project's own runner that relied on the old one now serializes nothing, and `TransactionTestCase._fixture_setup` restores no rows (`django/test/testcases.py:TransactionTestCase._fixture_setup`).

The notes name `BaseDatabaseCreation.serialize_db_to_string` (`django/db/backends/base/creation.py:BaseDatabaseCreation.create_test_db`; [What still warns: the deprecations and the releases that end them](deprecations.md)).
